title: Pure Krawler
summary: Pure Krawler and World Legacy build with Insect Links and staples. Krawlers are Level 2 EARTH Insect Flip monsters that trigger removal, search, or revival effects when flipped face-up, and each face-up Krawler that leaves the field because of an opponent's card effect Special Summons two differently named Krawlers from the Deck in face-down Defense Position.

summary.title: Starters
points: Krawler Soma flips a face-up monster you control face-down to Special Summon itself from the hand, then reduces its Level by 2 or 4 to Special Summon Krawlers from your hand, Deck, or GY whose total Levels equal the reduction.
Krawler Receptor searches any Krawler monster when flipped face-up, while Krawler Dendrite sends any monster from the Deck to the GY.
World Legacy Survivor excavates the top five cards of your Deck to add a Krawler or World Legacy card to your hand and sends the rest to the GY.

World Legacy in Shadow Special Summons a Level 2 or lower Insect from your hand in face-up or face-down Defense Position every turn and sends any opposing monster that battles your Flip monster to the GY.

summary.title: Opening: Any Monster + Krawler Soma
steps: Normal Summon a Krawler monster (or Special Summon one with World Legacy in Shadow), then activate Krawler Soma in your hand to flip that monster face-down and Special Summon Soma.
Reduce Soma's Level by 4 to Special Summon two Level 2 Krawlers (such as Krawler Receptor and Krawler Glial or Spine) from your Deck in face-up or face-down Defense Position.
Link Summon X-Krawler Qualiark or Lib the World Key Blademaster ( once a World Legacy card is in the GY) to Set World Legacy Pawns or World Legacy's Mind Meld directly from the Deck.

summary.title: Flip Swarm & X-Krawler Links
summary.text: Every main-deck Krawler—Receptor (search), Spine (destroy monster), Axon (destroy Spell/Trap), Glial (revive Krawler), Dendrite (mill monster), and Ranvier (recover two Krawlers from GY)—punishes removal by floating into two more Krawlers from the Deck if it leaves the field face-up due to an opponent's effect. The three X-Krawler Link-2 monsters (Qualiark, Neurogos, and Synaphysis) boost and protect the Krawlers they point to, and when destroyed or removed by the opponent, they revive two different Krawlers from your GY face-down.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Deus X-Krawler negates targeting effects that target it while face-down (flipping itself face-up in the process), and once it has been flipped face-up, it continuously negates all monster effects activated on the opponent's field.

World Legacy's Mind Meld changes an opponent's activated monster effect while you control a Krawler into returning a face-up monster the opponent controls to the hand, and banishes itself from the GY to summon a Krawler from hand, Deck, or GY face-down.

Lib the World Key Blademaster Sets a World Legacy Spell/Trap from the Deck and shuffles a card on the field into the Deck without targeting when used as Link Material. Note that World Legacy Survivor locks your Extra Deck to Link Monsters for the rest of the turn.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: World Legacy Pawns flips a face-down monster you control face-up on either turn to trigger its Flip effect, and shuffles a Krawler from your GY into the Deck to flip a face-up monster face-down again.
Crusadia Krawler Special Summons itself as a Level 2 Insect Trap Monster, and searches a World Legacy card if Special Summoned to a zone a Link Monster points to.
